beats.text: The US has 3,947 calories of food available daily. In Burundi, it is 1,698.
The US is the world's highest at retail level, with food wasted at home not subtracted.
Burundi is the world's lowest at 1,698 calories available per person daily.
The US has 2.3 times the food Burundi has.
India has 2,668 calories available per person daily.
